messages.subject: Project Granite — executed NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Edward, Grace,

Please find attached the mutual non-disclosure agreement, now executed by both sides. With the NDA in place we can begin sharing information and start preparing the Heads of Terms for the proposed acquisition of Calder Vale Foods.

James will set up the data room access this week and circulate a first due-diligence request list shortly.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
Partner
Whitfield Carter LLP

Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
